name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid Sales Order payload satisfying Glovia_Route_SalesOrder condition
expected_outcome: HTTP 200/202, headers (Region, Country, TimeStamp, BusinessObject, Sender) set, message routed via SequenceFlow_82 to CallActivity_102 mapping and logged via CallActivity_13, ending at EndEvent_2
validates: Content modifier header extraction, property InputPayload retention, router condition evaluation for sales order, mapping trigger, and generic header logging

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Alternative Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message satisfying Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder condition
expected_outcome: HTTP 200/202, headers set, message routed via SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71 generic headers and successfully completes at EndEvent_9
validates: Router branching for Return Sales Order path, execution of CallActivity_71, and clean completion without invoking Order mapping

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation End
trigger: Inbound SOAP message matching neither SalesOrder nor ReturnSalesOrder routing expressions
expected_outcome: Router directs flow via default SequenceFlow_110 to EndEvent_11 raising EscalationEndEvent with ErrorCode RoutingConditionNotMet
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default route handling and escalation error generation

name: Mapping Failure Triggers Exception Subprocess
trigger: Inbound SOAP message routing to SalesOrder branch but containing malformed XML body causing mapping failure in CallActivity_102
expected_outcome: SubProcess_91 catches error via StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 restores InputPayload from property, CallActivity_100 logs original payload, and terminates at EndEvent_95 (Error End)
validates: Exception Subprocess execution, property InputPayload restoration, payload attachment logging, and EndErrorEvent dispatch

name: SOAP Receiver Endpoint Simulation Failure / Downstream Timeout
trigger: Inbound request processed when downstream receiver mock responds with 500 Internal Server Error or Timeout
expected_outcome: Exception SubProcess_91 invoked, original payload logged from property.InputPayload, error propagated to sender
validates: System fault handling, timeout and retry isolation, and non-blocking exception logging
